title: 听力挑战 · 正式演讲

rounds.speaker: 主持人
rounds.line: Good morning, everyone. I welcome you to our annual meeting.
rounds.lineCn: 各位早上好,欢迎参加我们的年会。

grammar.name: 演讲开场常规句式
grammar.note: 演讲开场使用正常语序,搭配后文 never/seldom 等词引出倒装。

options.text: Thank you. It is an honor to be here.
options.feedback: 礼貌致谢,回应欢迎词得体专业。

options.text: It is raining outside right now.
options.feedback: 谈论天气,与正式场合的回应无关。
与正在进行的大会矛盾。

rounds.speaker: 演讲者
rounds.line: Never before have I seen such a supportive audience today.
rounds.lineCn: 今天我从没见过如此支持我的观众。

grammar.name: 否定副词置于句首倒装
grammar.note: Never 置于句首时,助动词提前构成部分倒装。

options.text: We are truly glad to have you with us.
options.feedback: 回应对方的热情发言,礼貌真诚。

options.text: You have seen a movie about us.
options.feedback: 曲解对方的话,与演讲主题无关。

options.text: The audience left early last night.
options.feedback: 与'支持观众'的发言矛盾。

rounds.speaker: 演讲者
rounds.line: Only by working together can we achieve our common goal.
rounds.lineCn: 只有团结合作,我们才能实现共同目标。

grammar.name: Only 置于句首倒装
grammar.note: only + 状语置于句首,主句用部分倒装 can we...

options.text: So let us join hands and begin.
options.feedback: 呼应对方号召,推动行动,符合演讲氛围。

options.text: We achieved the goal last month.
options.feedback: 与'尚未实现目标'的前提矛盾。
消极态度,与演讲号召不符。

rounds.speaker: 演讲者
rounds.line: Seldom do we get such a perfect opportunity in life.
rounds.lineCn: 人生中我们很少遇到这样完美的机会。

grammar.name: Seldom 置于句首倒装
grammar.note: seldom 等频度副词置于句首时,主语与助动词倒装。

options.text: We should surely make the most of it.
options.feedback: 呼应机会难得,提出行动建议,恰当。
曲解'机会难得'的含义,答非所问。
